---
name: Capability gap
about: Justify a proposed service, framework, adapter, agent, or cost
title: "Evaluate a demonstrated capability gap"
---

## Missing capability and acceptance test

Describe the exact failure the addition must solve.

## Existing options and evidence

What already-installed/local/free/subscribed capabilities were tried? Include reproducible results and simpler alternatives.

## Proposed smallest addition

Explain permissions, data transfer, credentials, compatibility, maintenance, and how the proposal fixes the gap.

## Cost and authorization

List estimated usage with assumptions, per-run/monthly caps, approval owner, review date, and removal plan. No purchase or billable routing is authorized merely by filing this issue.

## Verification plan

Compare the proposed option against the working baseline. Follow docs/COST_POLICY.md and the architecture escalation gates.
